name: Dossier
works_with: Local models through Ollama or LM Studio, or any OpenAI-compatible API, Anthropic or Mistral
short: A self-hosted job search app that writes a tailored resume and cover letter for each job from your own profile.
what: Dossier keeps your career history in one profile. For each job, it reads the posting, shows how you match, and drafts a resume and cover letter using only facts from your profile, with gaps shown instead of made up. You refine them in a chat, download PDFs and track each application from draft to offer. It can also search job sites, run a daily job agent and connect to Gmail and Google Calendar.
who: One job seeker who is comfortable running Docker. It is built for a laptop or desktop browser, not phones, and has one password and one profile, so it doesn't suit a team.
needs: Docker Desktop on macOS or Windows, or Docker Engine with the Compose plugin on Linux
An AI model, either local through Ollama or LM Studio, or a hosted one

steps.title: Fetch the Compose file and make secrets
steps.text: On an Apple Silicon Mac, the README has one extra line to add first.
steps.code:
mkdir ~/dossier && cd ~/dossier
curl -fsSL -o compose.yml https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AienTech/dossier/main/compose.production.yml
echo "POSTGRES_PASSWORD=$(openssl rand -hex 24)" > .env
echo "DOSSIER_SECRET=$(openssl rand -base64 32)" >> .env

steps.title: Choose your password
steps.text: This prints a hash starting with `argon2id:`. Add it to `.env` as `DOSSIER_PASSWORD=argon2id:…`.

steps.title: Start it
steps.text: The first start downloads about 1.7 GB. Then open http://localhost:3000, sign in and pick a model in Settings, then AI provider.

try.label: From the README
try.text: Start your profile from an existing resume, then paste a job posting into a new application and refine the tailored resume it writes in the chat.

watch: With a hosted model, your profile and documents go to that provider. A local model keeps them on your own hardware.
Gmail and Calendar access is optional and needs your own Google OAuth client. The README says nothing is sent without your confirmation.
The optional Claude connector can read your profile and applications and save drafts. It never sends or deletes anything.
Run only one copy of the app per database.
